text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wah! That's a huge crowd,
I wonder if an event is going on?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Laurel and the others!
Did you guys come here without knowing?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Its name is the "Mega Firm, Mega Rich, Mega Loaded!
3 Mega Bowl Chugging Challenge"!!
choice_data_list: Three entire servings of that huge portion!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A mega-drinking challenge...!
Sounds like fun! I wanna give it a shot♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hmm, not necessarily. If anything, I'm rather a small eater.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's precisely why! If we succeed at this challenge,
the sense of accomplishment will be immense!"
choice_data_list: Got it, then I'll be cheering you on!
Okay, then I'll cheer you on

text_block_list.name: Participant
text_block_list.text: Ngggh... I-I caaaan't...

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Another one dropped out...! There are only two left,
keep going until you clear the challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... J-Just a little more...!
After coming this far, I'm definitely clearing this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! As expected of you...
Still, I won't lose either...!

Both of them have incredible guts...!
It looks tough, but at this rate they might just drink it all—
choice_data_list: Hmm...? Wait, something's coming from over there—

text_block_list.name: Pet Dog
text_block_list.text: Bark bark bark bark bark!!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text: W-Whoa!? A-A dog is charging—!

Suddenly, an energetic dog knocked over the table,
spilling the Hachimii that was resting on it all over the ground!

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Aah...! S-So sorry!
This little one just loves honey, you see...!
choice_data_list: Not at all! I'm just glad neither of us got hurt.

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
B-But what are we gonna do? We can't even tell
how much was drunk like that, so there's no way we can keep going, right...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...... Excuse me, store clerk.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Could I get a fresh cup, please?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you wouldn't mind if I
continue the challenge, would you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh... WHAAAAT!?
I have to drink that whole amount AGAIN!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've come this far to challenge it.
—I definitely don't want to give up now!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"It's so unfortunate that you got injured right before Sports Day...
I'm so sorry I couldn't let you participate."

text_block_list.name: Young Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Uh-uh, it's okay! I'll just cheer you on
that much more!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, I always wanted to try lots of things,
like relays and cavalry battles.

text_block_list.name: Young Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"The ogre's gonna catch up to you!
Run, Chiyo-chan, run!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I wish I could play tag with everyone until I'm totally
exhausted..." That's what I used to think.
...But there were so many things I just couldn't do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's why being able to take on
any kind of challenge—is super fun!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens,
I want to do my best to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If we keep getting back up,
we'll reach the finish line eventually... right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooh... As many times as it takes, huh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Heh-heh! That's obvious!
After all, I'm the invincible Lord Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'll take a Hachimi too!
Let's clear this together, Laurel!
Refusing to give up—at its root is a pure, single-minded passion for taking on challenges.
"Then, what I can do for her as her Trainer is—"
choice_data_list: I believe you can absolutely do it!
I believe you all can absolutely do it!

text_block_list.text: "Then, what I can do for her as her Trainer is—"
choice_data_list: I believe you can absolutely do it!
I believe you all can absolutely do it!

text_block_list.text: "I supported them so their burden would be lightened, even just a little!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Puha...! How's that!
Nothing is impossible for the great Teio!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Trainer,
did you see that?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because you stayed right by my side
and took care of me, Trainer... Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. For even in the freezing winter,
sakura blossoms still bloom in full glory.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on... Those two are actually
gonna drink the whole thing...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! Challenge complete—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: We did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
When things got tough, I heard your voice, Trainer.
That's what gave me the strength to push through, you know? ...Fufu.
